annotations.title: Etsy seller question, answered in Etsy's words

description: Works without Etsy's API. Finds the closest of Growtsy's Etsy seller questions (reviews, messages, orders and shipping labels, refunds, listings, payments and deposits, account and shop settings) and returns Etsy Help Center sentences quoted word for word, each with the article, its id and the date Etsy last edited it, plus the Growtsy answer page. Deterministic word match, no AI, no paraphrase; 'no_match' when nothing fits. Use for 'how does Etsy … ?' questions about Etsy's own rules.
name: etsy_seller_answer
title: Etsy seller question, answered in Etsy's words
